Results.ReviewText: Cooks great!  I’ve had several friends who have had Weber’s that really liked them, so I finally bought one after we downsized from previous house. My Weber fits my new outdoor space perfectly. I grilled some bbq chicken that turned out to be the best I’ve ever grilled. And quick cleanup that the ash catcher provides.
Results.Title: Years of Weber envy

Results.ReviewText: Phenomenal product. Couldn’t be happier with any of the Weber products I’ve purchased. Everything is extremely high quality and exceeds all expectations.
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: What a game changer for my steaks. Love my new BBQ:  easy to play with direct/indirect heat with the baskets
Results.Title: A+

Results.ReviewText: I buy it like a month ago, and it make me sale my gaz bbq no more needed i cook on it 3 or 4 time a week on it. Its really easy and very versatile.
Results.Title: This is the best you can get for that price

Results.ReviewText: The only detail lacking in the current model is this: No 'hook' under the top, like older models, to hang over the edge of the grill. It's a hassle to place the top on the ground - or elsewhere - when working with whatever is being grilled.
Results.Title: Solid improvements but no 'hook' for the lid.

Results.ReviewText: I love everything about this grill. Honestly I ordered it for the ivory color. It goes great with my south beach pool scene. It cooks beautifully and has all kinds of extras. Awesome tasting food every time!
Results.Title: Beautiful and functional

Results.ReviewText: It's so nice to have the taste that only charcoal can bring after several years using gas grills! The Weber Master-Touch has all the features we wanted and is easy to use. We did have an issue with a part that didn't fit correctly, but Weber's representative got another one right to us very quickly and was so very courteous and professional while dealing with our request on the phone. I must give their customer service 10 stars!
Results.Title: Great grill and customer service!

Results.ReviewText:
Fantastic service and response for the Weber warranty dept.
I will recommend you all to everyone.
Results.Title: New Kettle owner

Results.ReviewText: Good old reliable kettle grill. One part arrived broken but was promptly replaced by customer service.  The Weber has been through several successful oils in the last few weeks.
Results.Title: Great tool to have

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely great grill. I use it all the time. I highly recommend this grill over any other charcoal grill I have used.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill ever.

Results.ReviewText: I have been using Weber grills for almost 40 years.  I have had 3 different 22" kettle grills in the past. This Master Touch is by far my favorite!  I love the lid holder and the Spring Green color is beautiful.
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill a little tricky putting it together by myself,,, but love grilling on it!
Results.Title: Go for the Master-Touch Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Received my new Weber for my 62nd birthday.  Been using an 18" kettle for years, 8-10, I think, The new Weber is so nice, so very nice, I love everything about it, the thermometer, the lid holder, the ability ro easily add more charcoal, where do I stop!?
Results.Title: FINALLY!!!!

Results.ReviewText:
Easy to use. Tall enough so you don’t have to bend over to cook. Buy a charcoal chimney. It makes it so much easier! I have always had a gas grill but I love the taste of a charcoal grill.

Download the app 3-D instructions. Much easier than the picture instructions included!
Results.Title: Love my first Weber Grill!!

Results.ReviewText: This is our third Weber kettle style grill.  We've enjoyed them for many years.  Still trying to adjust to the grill with the removable center section.  I used to hang the grill by its handle on the edge of the kettle when I was adding charcoal.  Can't do that now.  The center section will fall out.  So, what do I do with the grill while it is out of the kettle...?  Still love my Weber grill.
Results.Title: New and Improved...?

Results.ReviewText: Just tried it out yesterday and I'm a total newbie to grilling but the burgers were so delicious.  The grill is so easy to set up and use.  The features are functional and not useless additions to make it seem more high end.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: So in love with that grill, this is the third one I'm buying (I bought this one only for the colour) it fits well besides my summit
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: This product is an excellent improvement over my Weber of 2000! Venting is better. Temperature guage is excellent. Seal and control is much better. Thank you. I am glad I updated!
Results.Title: The upgrade!

Results.ReviewText: I just replaced my beat up 15 year old Weber grill, and it's made grilling so much easier with the lid holder. Temps get hotter now because of a better sealing lid, and my charcoal is lasting much longer.
Results.Title: Grilling is fun again!

Results.ReviewText: Nous avons acheté le bbq il y a 2 mois et nous sommes amplement satisfait ! Le seul point négatif est la poigné sur le dessus qui insiste a brûlure si tu ne porte pas attention
Results.Title: Super bbq !

Results.ReviewText: This grill works tremendously well and it made of quality materials
Results.Title: This is a great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, even easier with match light charcoal or a chimney starter and regular charcoal. Color is spot on. Easy to assemble too!
Results.Title: Easy to love grill

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill, I have used it on steak, burgers and fish.
Results.Title: Great

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback and for being a long-time Weber fan! We are very sorry to hear about the trouble you've been experiencing with reaching desired temperatures. We suggest using our chimney starter and filling it up to the top with coals if you have not already. Once the coals are lit, please place them in the charcoal grate and put the lid on top with both air vents fully opened to reach high temperatures. If you have any other questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText:
I'm a basic steak, burgers and chicken weekend griller, gone through at least two Weber classics over the years. This model does not build or retain heat like the classic, requires more coal to compensate. Results for me have been overcooked or under cooked food. In addition to the below comment from another reviewer, which I agree with, this model seems to have has a deeper kettle, charcoal further away from grate. I'm not into smoking meat and the grill is not working for me. No form, fit, or finish problems. 

"I’ve had several 22” Weber grills in the past. This new style master touch doesn’t seem to stay as hot for grilling/searing steaks with both top and bottom air vents open. My guess is with the new ash catching design, it doesn’t have adequate air flow for glowing white hot coals?"
Results.Title: Trouble Basic Griller

Results.ReviewText: Excellent purchase! This grill is more than enough for an amazing BBQ.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: The Master Touch lives true to the Weber reputation for quality. I chose the Master Touch over Weber’s other kettle offerings for the cold-touch vent handles, longer legs, and included char-baskets. I find the Gourmet BBQ System grate cutout to be a bit gimmicky: it makes the grate more tedious to clean and I have had it fall out of position on to the ground or into the coal bed with routine handling.
Results.Title: Great grill, not great grate

Results.ReviewText: So far this has been an excellent product. I've used it for smoking and grilling with great results for both occasions. It did have a slightly crushed end on one of the legs but I made it round again and it hasn't caused any issues and isn't noticable now.
Results.Title: Excellent product!

Results.ReviewText: I bought my master touch off Market Place in like new condition. I joined Weber Kettle Fans group on Facebook and have learned a lot. The MT was a game changer for me. For smaller cooks it is the most versatile kettle there is on the market!
Results.Title: The Master Touch rocks!

Results.ReviewText: Always. Happy. With weber kettle. Nothing cooks. Like a weber forsure
Results.Title: Very happy love the colors

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are the best, plus they come with a great warranty, so send in your registration after purchase.
Results.Title: Buy one today!

Results.ReviewText: My Weber Grill. I like grilling with charcoal because the flavor is great! I’ve grilled out on a Weber Grill for many years and will continue to. It’s the best!
Results.Title: My Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had an entry level weber kettle for about 15 years. Well, it finally wore out. So I got this master touch. It is indeed an upgrade. The lid holder is awesome, as is the cookind grate. The grate is heavier and thicker, and actually leaves nice sear marks. Just cooked Mother’s Day dinner for my wife, and it was literally the best ever!
Results.Title: Best Ever

Results.ReviewText: Love the master touch kettle! The added features are awesome. The kettle holds temps for a long time which makes it great for quick grilling or low and slow all day. The spring green color option was a great addition to the bling factor.
Results.Title: All around great for grilling and smoking

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sad to hear that your experience did not match your expectations. Please know that we take all feedback very seriously, and we will pass this to our design team. We hope that you can give us another try in the future. Thanks again!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: The Tripod configuration  creates a unbalanced effect when moving unit. Fully assembled for the first time moving unit, lifting with handle The Master-Touch fell backward. I returned it back to store.
Results.Title: Be careful when lifting.

Results.ReviewText: The center grille insert very handy for starting. The airflow controls actually work. Ash pan makes cleanup simple.
Results.Title: Ease of use.

Results.ReviewText:
My third and favorite Weber. You can’t go wrong with this one. I use it for direct, indirect and smoking. Everything from burgers and brats to pork butt and turkey breast. 
I use the coal baskets way more than I anticipated. I really like being able to move the the baskets from the center to the outsides to change up the intensity. 
Two things that took some getting used to were the center grate and the location of the thermometer. Every once in a while the center grate tries to slip up when I’m brushing the grill. Not a big issue. The second thing is the location of the thermometer. Weber should really consider moving it to the vent side. This makes it much more usable for smoking and indirect application. 
These issues aside, I would buy this kettle again with out a second thought.
Results.Title: Best tool in the backyard!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is super versatile! I use it for grilling, smoking, and stir frying. Heat is pretty easy to control with the bottom airflow adjuster once you get used to it. I think the lid rest on the master touch is a must have over the other models.
Results.Title: The one that does everything

ClientResponses.Response: I am very sorry that you are having a bad experience with your Master-Touch charcoal grill. We would love to help you replace the lid and bowl, if you would prefer. Please reach out to us at 800-446-1071 or email at support@weberstephen.com to let us know how we can assist you further with this.
ClientResponses.Name: Andrea Rudzin

Results.ReviewText: Dissapointed in fit and finish - Thin bowl and lid metal is easily deformed, resulting in lid not fitting properly.
Results.Title: Poor fit and finish

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We will take this into consideration as we design future models. We appreciate you being a long-time Weber fan. If there is anything else we can do to help please give us a call at 1-800-446-1071.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are terrific but I have found the grill with its movable and removable parts harder to clean than the one piece unit that comes with the original kettle. Consequently, I've been disappointed with this purchase.
Results.Title: Skip the master-touch

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
